This is the structure of profiles/<profile_id>/profile.json; the agent fills it in during the first setup (TODO_FOR_AI.md, A7) and removes example_only and every key that starts with _. Values the person must answer are null or empty here.

schedule._note_max_per_day: integer 1 to 44, taken from the person's own sending rule (sending_rule_statement); no default value; 44 means the whole month may go out on one day. A cv_submission is refused with DAILY_LIMIT when the number of cv_submission send_started lines already recorded for that local day (failed attempts included) has reached max_per_day (so with max_per_day 1 exactly one send per day is possible). For transport gmail_scheduled the day that counts is the local date of the slot (the day Gmail will send), not the day the scheduling was done; so a whole month can be scheduled in Gmail in one session. Applies in every mode; 0 and 45 or more are refused; a change takes effect from the next local day; the monthly limit of 44 is fixed (DATA_CONTRACT.md §13.2, item 9)

minutes_per_application._note: null until the person answers (TODO_FOR_AI.md, A7): their own values, or the example estimates of _allowed_values if the person accepts them; used only for the time-saved figure of the statistics (DATA_CONTRACT.md §9.3)

_allowed_values.languages.review_language: a language code the person checks the materials in (for example en, ru, de, uk); null until asked (TODO_FOR_AI.md, A7); separate from the sending languages and the report language
_allowed_values.languages.cv_language: default CV language for vacancies whose language is not stated; the vacancy language decides for each application; null until asked
_allowed_values.languages.cover_letter_language: default cover letter language, same rule as cv_language; null until asked
_allowed_values.languages.email_language: default e-mail text language, same rule as cv_language; null until asked
_allowed_values.languages.report_language: en, ru, de or uk, chosen by the person; independent of the other languages
_allowed_values.schedule.monthly_reminder_local_time: null until agreed in setup, then HH:MM local time (24 h); never assumed
_allowed_values.schedule.daily_check_time: HH:MM local time (24 h); default 16:00 in the person's time zone
_allowed_values.schedule.local_send_times: one HH:MM local time (24 h) per message of a run, or one time with inter_message_delay_minutes; an empty list with on_request
_allowed_values.schedule.max_per_run: integer from 1 up to max_per_day; null until asked and with on_request
_allowed_values.schedule.max_per_run_note: the number of slots in one run of a scheduled cadence; null with on_request
_allowed_values.schedule.sending_rule_statement: the person's own words on how the month's CV submissions are spread; required before any plan; never filled in by the agent
_allowed_values.schedule.max_per_day: integer 1–44 from the person's sending rule; null until stated (no default; the monthly limit 44 is fixed)
_allowed_values.schedule.inter_message_delay_minutes: null, or an integer of 1 or more; used when max_per_run is more than 1 and only one local time is given
_allowed_values.schedule.interval_days: null, or an integer of 1 or more; used only by every_n_calendar_days (calendar days) and every_n_allowed_workdays (permitted working days)
_allowed_values.schedule.cadence_on_request_note: on_request is allowed only with mail.mode approval_per_message: no fixed slot; the send time is the moment of the person's answer to the send card; no local_send_times, max_per_run, interval_days or inter_message_delay_minutes

minutes_per_application.example_estimate._note: example estimates (30 minutes in all); used only when the person says so, and to be replaced by their own values

_allowed_values.timezone: IANA name derived from the place of residence (A7); null until then
